Batch crawl stream produces expected Page and Complete events

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_concurrent' => 2 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
urls = ['https://example.com/page1', 'https://example.com/page2', 'https://example.com/page3']
result = Crawlberg.batch_crawl_stream(engine, urls).to_a
puts result.stream.event_count_min.inspect
puts result.stream.has_page_event.inspect
puts result.stream.has_complete_event.inspect
```
